plan: Given my private value of $9, I should bid conservatively to avoid overpaying. My goal is to win only if the third-highest bid is significantly lower than my value. I will bid slightly above half of my value to increase the chance of winning while minimizing the risk of paying too much. This approach maximizes potential profit if I win and minimizes loss if I lose. Hence, I will bid $5.

Given my private value of $45, I aim to win the auction while maximizing profit. I will bid slightly below my value to ensure a potential win without overpaying. A bid of $44.9 positions me to win without risking paying too much if others bid close to their maximum values. This strategy balances the risk of losing the auction with the potential profit from winning.

Given my private value for this item is $0, my optimal strategy is to not bid at all. Bidding any amount would result in a guaranteed loss, as I would pay the third-highest bid without gaining any value from the prize. Therefore, to maximize my profit, I should bid $0 and preserve my entire endowment.
